## DatePicker.svelte

### `interface Preset`

- `label` :: The visible name of the preset, e.g. "Today".
- `value` :: The ISO date the preset writes to `value`.

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The chosen date as ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null`. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the person changes the date.
- `min` :: The earliest selectable ISO date.
- `max` :: The latest selectable ISO date.
- `format` :: How the date is shown in the field.
- `clearable` :: Shows a button that clears the date.
- `presets` :: Quick-pick dates listed above the calendar.
- `locale` :: BCP 47 locale for parsing, formatting and calendar labels.
- `weekStartsOn` :: Day the week starts on, 0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the field. @default 'modern'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field as failing validation: a danger border and `aria-invalid`.
- `placeholder` :: The text shown while no date is chosen.
- `name` :: The name of the hidden input that carries the ISO date in a form submission.
- `open` :: Whether the calendar is showing. Bindable.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called when the calendar opens or closes.
- `disabled` :: Blocks opening the calendar and dims the field.
- `variant` :: The frame's visual style: `outline` draws the fill and border, while `ghost` and `secondary` drop the border.
- `surface` :: The recipe behind the calendar popover: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'glass'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the preset buttons inside the popover. @default 'text-sm'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the placeholder and of the calendar and clear buttons. @default 'text-muted'
